title: Test snapshot-prioritized fresh on-policy collection
doing: Propose ordinary initial states versus a preregistered mixture of reachable pre-pattern snapshots, with two training seeds per arm. Restore simulator/wrapper state exactly and collect fresh current-policy actions; do not replay old actions as on-policy PPO data. Declare training-only snapshot selection and altered initial-state distribution; no launch.
expected: Snapshot starts may provide denser relevant experience than static hard-seed labels, but can overfit local situations or harm full-game state coverage. Failed static priority does not establish the outcome of this different mechanism.
